functions.evidence: Uses the second argument as the gate, runs the mapped gate destruction checks, and never frees the gate allocation. This is the rw gate destroy wrapper. osfmk/kern/locks.c:3159.
Moves the gate from the second argument to the first and tail-branches to the mapped gate_open helper. osfmk/kern/locks.c:3547.
Moves the gate from the second argument to the first and tail-branches to the mapped gate_steal helper. osfmk/kern/locks.c:3607.
Clears the current CPU read-side sequence with a release store and decrements the preemption count, with the underflow path already paired. osfmk/kern/smr.c:684.
Looks up a 32-bit errno for Mach results 0 through 56 and returns EIO otherwise. The 57-element lookup table is byte-identical to the native kernel table. osfmk/kern/bsd_kern.c:1392.
Tests nonzero phys_addr, then returns the inverse of bit 1 of the second UPL word. That bit is absent in the 8-byte entry. osfmk/vm/vm_pageout.c:10409 and osfmk/mach/memory_object_types.h:745.
Tests the first 32-bit word of the indexed 8-byte UPL entry for nonzero. The word is phys_addr in the verified UPL ABI. osfmk/vm/vm_pageout.c:10394 and osfmk/mach/memory_object_types.h:482.
Tests nonzero phys_addr and extracts bit 2 of the flags word, the dirty bit in the 8-byte UPL ABI. osfmk/vm/vm_pageout.c:10404 and osfmk/mach/memory_object_types.h:739.
Waits on the vnode using the buf_bawrite diagnostic name, then calls the mapped vnop_bwrite_desc operation on the buffer. bsd/vfs/vfs_bio.c:2738.
Selects read/write mount limits with CL_READ=1 and CL_WRITE=2, then applies the UPL limit and page rounding. The native routine computes this with the native PAGE_SHIFT. bsd/vfs/vfs_cluster.c:401.
Takes the vnode lock, sets SI_MOUNTEDON bit 0 in specinfo flags, and releases the lock. bsd/vfs/kpi_vfs.c:2409.
Takes the vnode lock, clears SI_MOUNTEDON bit 0 in specinfo flags, and releases the lock. bsd/vfs/kpi_vfs.c:2417.
Constructs arguments containing the mapped vnop_fsync_desc, vnode, waitfor integer and vfs context, then calls the vnode operation. bsd/vfs/kpi_vfs.c:4372.
Constructs the two-word arguments containing the mapped vnop_strategy_desc and the buffer, then dispatches via the buffer vnode operation table. bsd/vfs/kpi_vfs.c:6423.
Checks the 16-entry event watcher array then returns false for vnode tag VT_DEVFS=18. bsd/vfs/vfs_fsevents.c:320.
Consumes thread ID, debug ID and argument, supplies the current thread ID for zero, then records to the triage buffer with preemption disabled. bsd/kern/kdebug_triage.c:178.
BTI and a tail branch to the mapped uiomove64. The source wrapper preserves x0/x1/x2 and forwards the pointer as addr64_t. bsd/kern/kern_subr.c:227.
